answer: Weight each attestation by what the attester has received from the same identity, so mutual back scratching nets to near zero, and cap every identity at 2 graded answers per epoch while the auditor pool rotates on a fixed schedule. Step one is the cap, step two the weighting, step three the rotation. A vine of accounts that only vouch for each other grows nothing, and a nebula of 500 wallets hits the cap long before it reaches the zenith of a payout.
